title: Daniel Interprets Nebuchadnezzar's Dream
description: Daniel interprets Nebuchadnezzar's dream about a statue made of gold, silver, bronze, iron, and clay, which is shattered by a stone—a picture of coming kingdoms and God's eternal kingdom.
